Westland, Michigan Pest Control

Rose Pest Solutions proudly serves the businesses and homeowners of Westland and surrounding areas, out of our Metro Detroit West District office in Livonia, Michigan. We provide eco-friendly, affordable pest control services to fit each one of our customer’s unique needs. Rose technicians receive ongoing education to stay up-to-date with the latest pest control technology. Our philosophy combines inspection, prevention and treatment, to help our customers get rid of pests, and prevent them from returning.

Services Offered

Residential Pest Control for common household bugs and rodents

Commercial Pest Control Services

Integrated Pest Management

Bed Bug Detection and Treatment

Termite control featuring the Sentricon© Termite Colony Elimination System

Mosquito control for the home and for businesses

Wildlife Removal for rodents, squirrels, raccoons and other nuisance wildlife

Contact Rose Pest Solution In Westland Michigan today to schedule an inspection!

For Year-Round Protection Consider The Rose Home Service Program.

The Rose Home Service Program offers regularly scheduled pest control services for a single annual price, designed to identify and prevent infestations of the most common pests. Whether you're dealing with ants, spiders, or other common invaders, our Home Service Programs provide year-round protection and peace of mind.
